summary.text: Britt Raybould represents Idaho House District 34, Seat B, and lives in the Rexburg area; the Idaho Legislature's member page lists a second stint in the House, after one earlier term (2018-2020).

paragraphs.text: The legislature biography says Raybould was born and raised in eastern Idaho and graduated from Sugar-Salem High School, Boise State University, and Westminster College.
The biography lists work as chief financial officer of Raybould Brothers Farms, founding of the consulting firm Write Bold, and a past presidency of the National Potato Council.
